item.title: Why Structured Data Is Essential for Your SEO
item.description: Structured data isn't just a "nice to have" - it's metadata that tells search engines exactly what's on your page. With structured data, Google can show rich results that significantly increase visibility and clicks.
item.author: info@weboptim.eu (Peter Gáborík)

item.title: Star Reviews, Star Sales: The Power of Customer Feedback in E-Commerce
item.description: In a digital world full of possibilities, where physical contact with products or sellers is missing, reviews replace personal experience and become a bridge of trust between brands and consumers.
